name: ScanBack Kids 96-design development artwork register
scope: development-only; no storefront, payment, order, or print permission changes
approval_statement: 96 catalog positions filled with existing image paths. Only 20 have recovered-original gallery references. Neither preview assets nor recovered gallery references constitute commercial print approvals.

known_rejections.reason: User confirmed visual mismatch; do not promote

commercial_print_audit.phase: Continue source/identity QA using user-approved V6.15 A4 layout; no repeat layout redesign
gates: Standalone master present and native pixels validated at final artwork placement
Die-cut and rounded rectangle printer proof approved
Physical proof and QR scan checks passed

estimated_elapsed_working_days.total: 11–22 working days after original assets and printer specifications available

commercial_print_audit.limitations: Dates are planning estimates, not a background execution commitment; physical signoff requires printer and actual proofs.
commercial_print_audit.next_gate: Measure 9 candidate masters in native pixels, compare identities, then recover missing 87; no print approval without passed checks
commercial_print_audit.warning: A4 contact proof is visual-only, not cut-ready production proof.

master_dimension_audit.note: Pixel dimensions alone do not establish sufficient resolution at final printed size or authenticity; sports/04 remains rejected.

digital_resolution_screen.note: Resolution-only gate; no identity or printing approval implied

step_2_3.interpretation: Geometric page fit and lack of tile overlap pass for both layouts. This is not a visual proof of artwork bleed or legibility, nor a QR scan check. Test before print approval.

step_2_4.basis: Reviewed actual Studio source functions composeOne, pdfQR and pdfContour

findings.bleed_coverage: FAIL_VISUAL_ARTWORK_BLEED: artwork inset by 0.8mm inside trim, only theme flat color fills outer bleed
findings.small_text: REVIEW: captions and labels use very small fonts on rounded labels

recommendations: Do not certify illustrated full-bleed until background art extends beyond cut boundary.
Render sample A4 PDFs for both geometries and inspect actual text and QR at 100%.
Check real QR URLs using multiple density cases and scan exported codes.
Retain commercial-print block for all 96 until source identities and content gates pass.

step_2_8.scope: Independent A4 geometry/layout demonstration with placeholders; not Studio exported live-order proof
step_2_8.rendering_check: Example reportlab PDFs generated and rasterized for manual inspection; artwork placeholders, demo QR
step_2_8.reference_layout_disposition: Supplementary test only; not a replacement for approved V6.15 proof

step_2_9.scope: Source and identity readiness across 96 positions; no layout modification
step_2_9.identity_limitations: Gallery references do not prove print candidate visually matches approved original; rejected mappings remain blocked
step_2_9.next_gate: Obtain and compare authentic masters for outstanding catalog positions; certify candidates only after identity and pixel quality review

layout_baseline.policy: Preserve approved artwork positions, QR/name geometry, page arrangement, text hierarchy and trim layout. Do not restart or redesign layout. Only change if objective evidence reveals a functional defect, and obtain explicit approval before doing so.
layout_baseline.note: Approval supplied by user; original proof file not independently compared in this audit.
remaining_scope: Verify remaining artwork identity and source-file quality
Validate artwork against locked layout without moving QR/name/cut positions
Confirm representative QR scanning and export quality against approved proof
Create final 96-design artwork register with exceptions clearly marked
